[size=3]Welcome to Sunpower Seeds! 

[/size]This mod adds edible sunflower seeds that give your character a buff when eaten!

[b]Coffee Sunpower Seeds
[/b] -- Recipe 
 == 1 Sunflower Seed
 == 3 Coffee Beans
 -- Effect
 == +1 Speed for 42s
 -- Recipe purchased from Pierre for 1000g

[b]Iron Sunpower Seeds
[/b] -- Recipe 
 == 1 Sunflower Seed
 == 2 Iron Ore
 -- Effect
 == +1 Magnetism for 1:52s
 -- Recipe purchased from the Dwarf for 1000g

[b]Fishy Sunpower Seeds
[/b] -- Recipe 
 == 1 Sunflower Seed
 == 4 Bait
 -- Effect
 == +1 Fishing for 1:10s
 -- Recipe purchased from Willy for 1000g

[b]Garlic Sunpower Seeds
[/b] -- Recipe 
 == 1 Sunflower Seed
 == 1 Garlic
 -- Effect
 == +1 Defense for 1:10s
 -- Recipe purchased from Clint for 1000g

[b]Spicy Sunpower Seeds
[/b] -- Recipe 
 == 1 Sunflower Seed
 == 1 Hot Pepper
 -- Effect
 == +1 Attack for 1:10s
 -- Recipe purchased from Marlon for 1000g

[b]Tea Sunpower Seeds
[/b] -- Recipe 
 == 1 Sunflower Seed
 == 1 Tea Leaves
 -- Effect
 == +20 Max Energy for 1:10s
 -- Recipe purchased from Harvey for 1000g

[b]Wild Sunpower Mix
[/b] -- Recipe 
 == 1 Sunflower Seed
 == 1 Mixed Seeds
 -- Effect
 == +1 Foraging for 1:10s
 -- Recipe purchased from Harvey for 1000g


[img]https://i.imgur.com/LKwk9jp.png[/img]

[size=3]This is my first mod ever, so I haven't considered balance in too too much, but I've done my best with a small amount of research.

[/size][img]https://i.imgur.com/Eqdpuvd.png[/img]

﻿﻿- Latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url]
- Latest version of [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Installing_SMAPI]SMAPI[/url]
- Latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/kLbxt2U.png[/img]

﻿Step 1. Install SMAPI, Json Assets, and SpaceCore.
Step 2. Download this mod and extract the zip file anywhere you would like.
Step 3. Drag & Drop the extracted folder directly into the /Mods folder.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/MnkF0nq.png[/img]

- Delete every existing food item made from this mod
- Remove the corresponding folder(s) inside /Mods
﻿
If you miss any (especially in your inventory) you can crash your game.
